body:
`dispatch` (xMuramasa/hermes-dispatch#2) moves delegate runs out of scratch into `~/.local/state/hermes-runs/` and writes `<name>.run.json` beside each run (contract: hermes-dispatch SPEC.md section 2). The app can then link a run to its issue (xMuramasa/trismegistus-mac#50).

- [ ] Default `-runs` to `~/.local/state/hermes-runs` (and the unit file); keep reading the old scratch folder as a second dir until it is empty
- [ ] `Agent` gains `repo` (`xMuramasa/<repo>`) and `issue` (number) from `<name>.run.json`; absent when the file is missing
- [ ] Finished runs listed 7 days instead of 24 h (the files now stay 30 days)
- [ ] Tests for both folders, a missing or malformed `run.json`, and ids staying inside the relay's `agentIDRe`
- [ ] No relay change needed: the relay passes the helper's JSON through (`relay/internal/server/agents.go`); confirm with a test

Done when: tests pass; after the rebuild and restart, `GET /api/agents` through the relay shows `repo` and `issue` for a run started by `dispatch`.

labels.name: hermes
labels.description: Hermes may take this issue on its own

title: Agents helper: read runs from ~/.local/state/hermes-runs and name each run's issue
